recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11555 unless CDS reopens the broader timing-choice policy for PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration together.
issue_request: FHIR-11555 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request asking whether Timing should be a data type choice for GuidanceResponse/RequestGroup timing as it was for PlanDefinition.
initial_application: Git-svn commit e6bd9dd0e0 / SVN r10173 explicitly applied #11554 and #11555 by aligning RequestGroup action elements with PlanDefinition and changing RequestGroup.action.timing[x] from dateTime|Period|Duration|Range to dateTime|Period|Duration|Range|Timing.
additional_context: RequestGroup was later renamed to RequestOrchestration, and fhir.ini now lists RequestOrchestration as the active resource while mapping RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. GuidanceResponse.result can target RequestOrchestration, and later timing-choice updates added other types without removing Timing.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because RequestOrchestration.action.timing[x] includes Timing and PlanDefinition.action.timing[x] also includes Timing.
